sentences.en: Juha bought a bag of onions at the market.
The road was long and the bag heavy.

sentences.ar: כל כמה דקות הוא עצר וספר את הבצל.
sentences.en: Every few minutes he stopped and counted the onions.
Someone asked: why are you counting?

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: כשאני סופר אני שוכח שאני עייף.
sentences.en: He said: when I count I forget that I am tired.
